_comment_GlobalConfig: GlobalConfig:Path and Observability:LogFile:Directory are machine-specific — set GlobalConfig:Path in your own gitignored appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example), and put Observability:LogFile:Directory inside your globalconfig.json alongside the other per-machine values.

Identity._comment_JwksUri: appsettings.json's default omits a port (relies on Docker's kart-identity-service DNS name); this overrides it to kart-identity-service's own local dev port (its launchSettings.json http profile) for a bare-metal `dotnet run` against a locally-running identity service.
